annoy_delay_minutes.description: Minutes to wait after power failure before warning users (ANNOYDELAY)

battery_level_percent.description: Minimum battery charge (%) that triggers forced shutdown if runtime estimate unavailable

device_options.description: Additional device-specific options (e.g., baud rate for serial, like '-b 9600'). Appended to DEVICE line.

device_path.description: Device path (e.g., /dev/ttyS0) for SERIAL; empty for USB autodetection; host:port for NET

min_runtime_minutes.description: Minimum remaining runtime (minutes) before forced shutdown

nis_enabled.description: Enable Network Information Server (NETSERVER in config)

nis_ip.description: IP address to bind NIS daemon to (NISIP in config)

nis_port.description: Port for NIS daemon (NISPORT in config)

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) UPS will power connected devices before forced shutdown

ups_type.description: UPS communication type: USB, SERIAL, or NET (networked UPS)

upscable.description: Type of cable connecting the UPS to the computer.
